news.title: Old Hulls, New Money: Why the VLCC Market Has Stopped Counting Years

news.title: Trump Denies Offering Iran Sanctions Relief, Tehran Says it is Ready for Talks
news.summary: US President Donald Trump said he has offered Iran nothing to end the war, rejecting media reports that cited US officials saying he was willing to ease sanctions and release frozen funds for "concrete" steps regarding Iran's nuclear program.
